name: Battle Familiar
description:
You summon a familiar shaped like an animal of your choice into an unoccupied space within range. It is a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice) and uses the Battle Familiar stat block below; when you cast the spell, pick the Brute, Flyer, or Stalker form, which changes some of its numbers. It is an ally to you and your allies, rolls its own Initiative, and acts on its own turn. It vanishes when the spell ends, when it drops to 0 Hit Points, or when you die, leaving in its space whatever it was wearing or carrying. When you cast the spell again, you can call back the same familiar or a different one.

One Familiar at a Time. You can have only one familiar from this spell; casting it again replaces the old one with the new one. If you already have a familiar from Find Familiar when you cast it, the spell empowers that familiar instead of summoning a new one: for the duration it can attack in addition to its other actions as normal and uses the Battle Familiar stat block, but it keeps its own creature type, alignment, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, and Find Familiar features. It also gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the battle familiar's Hit Points. The spell ends early once those Temporary Hit Points are gone, any that remain vanish when the spell ends, and the familiar then returns to its previous form.

Battle Familiar. Medium Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice), Neutral. AC 11 + the spell's level (+2 more for the Brute). Initiative +3 (13). HP 30 (Brute) or 20 (Flyer or Stalker), + 5 for each spell level above 2. Speed 40 ft., Swim 30 ft.; the Flyer also has Fly 30 ft. (hover). STR 16 (+3), DEX 16 (+3), CON 12 (+1), INT 8 (-1), WIS 13 (+1), CHA 10 (+0); its saving throw bonuses equal these modifiers. Immunities: Charmed, Frightened. Senses: Passive Perception 11. Languages: understands the languages you know.

Traits. Flyby (Flyer only): it doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach. Talented: it adds half the spell's level (round down) to every ability check and saving throw it makes.

Actions. Multiattack: it makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down), and it can swap one of them for Prowl if it has Prowl. Rend: Melee Attack Roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level Force damage. Prowl (Stalker only): it moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then can take the Hide action.
eli5: Summon a Brute, Flyer, or Stalker battle familiar that fights on its own turn for an hour, or power up the familiar you already have from Find Familiar.
higherLevelSlot: Use the spell slot's level as the spell's level everywhere in the stat block (AC, Hit Points, Talented, number of Rend attacks, and Rend damage).

name: Disruptive Tune
description: A jarring melody fills a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw. A creature that fails loses Concentration on whatever it is concentrating on and, for the spell's duration, has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws it makes to maintain Concentration.
eli5: Creatures in a 20-foot sphere that fail a Constitution save drop their Concentration and struggle to keep it for the next minute.

name: Dueling Ground
description:
You mark out a dueling ground: a glowing circle of runes bounding a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point on the ground you touch. While creating it, you choose two willing creatures inside the Sphere as the duelists. The spell ends early if any creature other than a duelist enters the Sphere.

If a duelist drops to 0 Hit Points inside the dueling ground, it becomes Stable and teleports to the nearest unoccupied space outside the ground. If a duelist inside is subjected to an effect that would kill it outright without dealing damage, it survives at 0 Hit Points with the Unconscious condition, becomes Stable, and teleports to the nearest unoccupied space outside. When only one duelist is left inside, a crown of runes like those around the circle briefly flashes around its head.
eli5: Draw a magic dueling circle for two willing fighters where a loser who drops to 0 Hit Points is stabilized and teleported out instead of dying.
higherLevelSlot: You can choose one more willing creature as a duelist for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Uncertain Footing
description: Illusory obstacles such as rocks and spikes appear around up to three creatures you can see within range. Each target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, its Speed is halved and it can't take the Dash action. An affected target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
eli5: Up to three creatures that fail an Intelligence save move at half Speed and can't Dash until they shake off the illusion.

name: Wither and Bloom
material: a withered vine twisted into a loop
description: Death and life surge through a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Each creature you choose in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Nonmagical plants in the area that aren't creatures, such as trees and shrubs, wither. In addition, one creature of your choice in the area can roll one of its unspent Hit Point Dice and regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your spellcasting ability modifier; that die is then spent.
eli5: Hurt the creatures you pick in a 10-foot sphere with 3d6 necrotic damage while one creature there spends a Hit Point Die to heal.
higherLevelSlot: For each spell slot level above 2, the damage increases by 1d6 and the chosen creature can roll and spend one more Hit Point Die. Your spellcasting ability modifier is added to the healing only once, however many dice are rolled.

name: Catnap
description: With a soothing gesture, you give up to three willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range the Unconscious condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake. A target that stays Unconscious from this spell for the full 10 minutes gains the benefits of finishing a Short Rest, and it can't be affected by this spell again until it finishes a Long Rest.
eli5: Put up to three willing allies to sleep for 10 minutes so they get the benefits of a Short Rest if nobody wakes them.
higherLevelSlot: You can target one more willing creature for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Inflict Doubt
description: You fill a creature you can see within range with self-doubt. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have Disadvantage on D20 Tests for the duration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
eli5: A creature that fails a Wisdom save has Disadvantage on every D20 Test until it passes a later save.

name: Distorted Distance
description:
You warp the apparent space inside a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. When you cast the spell, you can apply one of the effects below to each creature you can see in the Sphere. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature enters the Sphere or ends its turn there, you can apply one of them to that creature. A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.

Dizzying Elongation. The creature makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d10 Psychic damage, and the Sphere is Difficult Terrain for it until the end of its turn.

Shortened Space. The creature's Speed increases by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.
eli5: Bend space in a 60-foot sphere so enemies take psychic damage and slog through Difficult Terrain while allies move 20 feet faster.

name: Festering Blast
description: A 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line of miasma blasts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d10 Necrotic damage and has the Poisoned condition for the duration. A creature Poisoned by this spell takes 2d10 Poison damage at the start of each of its turns and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
eli5: Blast a 60-foot line of rot that deals 4d10 necrotic damage and leaves creatures that fail Poisoned, taking 2d10 poison damage each turn.
higherLevelSlot: The initial damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Zone of Amicability
description: A 60-foot Emanation of goodwill radiates from you for the duration. Whenever you make an ability check to influence a creature in the Emanation, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
eli5: For 10 minutes, your d20 rolls to influence creatures within 60 feet of you never count as lower than 10.

name: Enervation
description: A tendril of inky darkness lashes out at a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 6d8 Necrotic damage, and on each of your later turns you can take a Bonus Action to deal 2d8 Necrotic damage to it automatically; the spell ends if the target is ever outside the spell's range or has Total Cover from you. On a successful save, it takes half the initial damage only, and the spell ends. Whenever this spell deals damage, you regain Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt.
eli5: Drain a creature for 6d8 necrotic damage, then 2d8 more as a Bonus Action each turn, healing yourself for half of all the damage dealt.
higherLevelSlot: The initial damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Grave Ground
description: Skeletal hands erupt from the ground in an area within range made of up to four 10-foot squares, arranged as you like as long as each square touches at least one other. The area is Difficult Terrain for your enemies. Each enemy in the area when the hands appear makes a Strength saving throw, and an enemy also makes it when it enters the area or ends its turn there, but no more than once per turn. On a failed save, it takes 6d6 Necrotic damage and subtracts 1d6 from all its damage rolls until the end of its next turn.
eli5: Skeletal hands grab enemies in up to four 10-foot squares, slowing them and dealing 6d6 necrotic damage that also weakens their hits.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Mordenkainen's Lucubration
description: You regain up to two of your expended spell slots, each of level 2 or lower.
eli5: Spend a level 5 slot to get back up to two used spell slots of level 2 or lower.
higherLevelSlot: With a level 6 or 7 spell slot, the regained slots can be up to level 3; with a level 8 or higher spell slot, up to level 4.

name: Negative Energy Flood
material: a broken bone and a square of black silk
description: Ribbons of negative energy strike one creature you can see within range. If the target isn't Undead, it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d10 + 25 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this spell rises as a Zombie at the start of your next turn and obeys your spoken orders for 24 hours, after which it acts according to its nature. If the target is Undead, it instead gains 3d10 Temporary Hit Points.
eli5: Hit a living creature for 3d10 + 25 necrotic damage, raising slain Humanoids as zombies that obey you for a day, or give an Undead target temporary hit points.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Spirit Lantern
description:
A ghostly black lantern floats above you for the duration, shedding Dim Light in a 60-foot radius. When an enemy dies in that Dim Light, a fragment of its soul flies into the lantern. The lantern holds a number of soul fragments up to your spellcasting ability modifier, and any it still holds vanish when the spell ends. As a Bonus Action, you can spend one fragment to create one of these effects:

Drain Life. A creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking Necrotic damage equal to 4d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Repair Undead. An Undead creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you regains Hit Points equal to 4d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Ward Ally. Until the start of your next turn, other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against a creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you.
eli5: A ghostly lantern collects the souls of enemies who die near you, and you spend them as a Bonus Action to drain foes, heal Undead, or protect an ally.

name: Summon Plant
description:
You call up the spirit of an animated plant, choosing the Fungus, Tree, or Vine form. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range and uses the Plant Spirit stat block below; the form changes some of its details. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat it shares your Initiative count but takes its turn immediately after yours, and it obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you); if you give none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. It vanishes when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

Plant Spirit. Large Plant, Neutral. AC 11 + the spell's level (+2 more for the Tree). Initiative +1 (11). HP 50 + 10 for each spell level above 5. Speed 40 ft.; the Vine also has Climb 40 ft. STR 17 (+3), DEX 13 (+1), CON 14 (+2), INT 10 (+0), WIS 13 (+1), CHA 10 (+0); its saving throw bonuses equal these modifiers. Vulnerabilities: Fire (Tree only), Slashing (Fungus or Vine only). Senses: Passive Perception 11. Languages: understands the languages you know.

Traits. Siege Monster (Tree only): it deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions. Multiattack: it makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down). Slam (Tree or Vine only): Melee Attack Roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 1d10 + 3 + the spell's level Bludgeoning damage. Spore Spray (Fungus only): Melee or Ranged Attack Roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft.; Hit: 1d4 + the spell's level Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn; if the target is already Poisoned, it takes an extra 3d4 Poison damage instead.

Bonus Actions. Twist Away (Vine only): it takes the Dash or Disengage action.
eli5: Summon a Fungus, Tree, or Vine plant spirit that fights for you, acts right after your turn, and follows your spoken commands.
higherLevelSlot: Use the spell slot's level as the spell's level everywhere in the stat block (AC, Hit Points, number of attacks, and damage).

name: Waves of Exhaustion
description: A flickering gray nimbus surrounds you. For the duration, you can take a Magic action to send a wave of gray light through a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Exhaustion level. This spell can't raise a creature's Exhaustion level above 4, and every Exhaustion level it caused is removed when the spell ends.
eli5: For a minute, use a Magic action to blast a 60-foot cone that gives each creature failing a Constitution save a level of Exhaustion, which goes away when the spell ends.

name: Summon Dinosaur
description:
You call up the spirit of a primeval dinosaur, choosing the Ankylosaur, Triceratops, or Tyrannosaur form. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range and uses the Dinosaur Spirit stat block below; the form changes some of its details. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat it shares your Initiative count but takes its turn immediately after yours, and it obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you); if you give none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. It vanishes when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

Dinosaur Spirit. Huge Beast (Dinosaur), Neutral. AC 11 + the spell's level (+2 more for the Ankylosaur). Initiative +0 (10). HP 60 + 10 for each spell level above 6. Speed 40 ft. STR 21 (+5), DEX 11 (+0), CON 15 (+2), INT 4 (-3), WIS 12 (+1), CHA 9 (-1); its saving throw bonuses equal these modifiers. Senses: Passive Perception 11. Languages: understands the languages you know.

Traits. Siege Monster (Ankylosaur only): it deals double damage to objects and structures. Tough: it adds half the spell's level (round down) to its Strength and Constitution saving throws.

Actions. Multiattack: it makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down). Bite (Tyrannosaur only): Melee Attack Roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 10 ft.; Hit: 2d10 + 5 + the spell's level Piercing damage, and a Large or smaller target has the Grappled condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC) and has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. Gore (Triceratops only): Melee Attack Roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 1d10 + 5 + the spell's level Piercing damage; if the target is Huge or smaller and the spirit moved at least 20 feet straight toward it right before the hit, the target takes an extra 1d10 Piercing damage and has the Prone condition. Slam (any form): Melee Attack Roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 10 ft.; Hit: 1d10 + 5 + the spell's level Bludgeoning damage.
eli5: Summon a Huge Ankylosaur, Triceratops, or Tyrannosaur spirit that fights for you, acts right after your turn, and follows your spoken commands.
higherLevelSlot: Use the spell slot's level as the spell's level everywhere in the stat block (AC, Hit Points, Tough, number of attacks, and damage).

name: Aura of Evasion
description: A 30-foot Emanation of quickness radiates from you for the duration. You and your allies in it have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. When an affected creature makes a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, it instead takes no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure. A creature with the Incapacitated condition gets no benefit from the aura.
eli5: You and allies within 30 feet get Advantage on Dexterity saves and take no damage on a success and only half on a failure, like the Evasion feature.

name: Fractured Awareness
description: You flood a creature you can see within range with clashing visions of possible futures. It makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 12d10 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests for the duration; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only, and the spell ends.
eli5: A creature takes 12d10 psychic damage and has Disadvantage on every D20 Test until it passes an Intelligence save, or takes half damage if it passes right away.

name: Power Word Pain
description: You speak a word of power at one creature you can see within range. If the target has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it takes 6d8 Force damage and has the Charmed condition for the duration; otherwise, it takes the 6d8 Force damage only. While Charmed this way, its Speed can't be more than 10 feet, and it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests other than Constitution saving throws. Whenever it tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the spell fails with no effect and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted (a spell slot used for it isn't expended). At the end of each of its turns, the Charmed target makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success.
eli5: Deal 6d8 force damage, and a target with 100 Hit Points or fewer is wracked with pain that slows it, gives it Disadvantage, and can spoil its spellcasting.

name: Reweave Fate
castingTrigger: which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you fails a D20 Test
description: You tug on a single thread of fate. The creature that failed the D20 Test can reroll it with Advantage and must use the new roll. If the new roll succeeds, the creature gains 6d10 Temporary Hit Points.
eli5: As a reaction when a creature within 60 feet fails a D20 Test, it rerolls with Advantage and gains 6d10 temporary hit points if the reroll succeeds.

name: Transfix
description: Your appearance becomes alluring and otherworldly for the duration. One creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, it has the Incapacitated condition, and if it is more than 5 feet away from you, on its turn it moves toward you by the most direct route to get within 5 feet of you. If it ends its turn within 5 feet of you, it takes 4d8 Psychic damage. It doesn't avoid Opportunity Attacks while moving toward you, but before it moves into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit), it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. On your later turns while the spell lasts, you can take a Magic action to target another creature, but never one that has succeeded on a save against this casting.
eli5: A creature that fails a Charisma save is drawn helplessly toward you and takes 4d8 psychic damage each turn it ends next to you.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 7.

name: Entrancing Mirrors
description: Dozens of illusory mirrors surround up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range. Each target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 7d6 Psychic damage and has the Stunned condition, and its Speed is halved while it is Stunned. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A Stunned target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
eli5: Up to three creatures that fail an Intelligence save take 7d6 psychic damage and are Stunned until they pass a later save.

name: Illusory Dragon
description:
You weave shadow material from the Shadowfell into a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It lasts for the duration and occupies its space as if it were a creature; it is tangible but has Immunity to all damage and conditions. When it appears, each enemy that can see it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the enemy drops whatever it is holding and has the Frightened condition for the duration. A creature Frightened this way that ends its turn in a space without line of sight to the dragon repeats the save, ending the condition on itself on a success.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the dragon up to 60 feet, and at one point during that movement you can have it exhale a 60-foot Cone of energy. Each creature in the Cone makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking 6d6 damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type is Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison, chosen when you create the dragon.

A creature that takes the Study action to examine the dragon can recognize it as an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. A creature that discerns the illusion sees through the image and has Advantage on saving throws to end the Frightened condition it caused and against its breath.
eli5: Create a terrifying shadow dragon that Frightens enemies and, as a Bonus Action, moves and breathes a 60-foot cone for 6d6 damage.

name: Iron Body
material: diamond dust worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: A willing creature you touch becomes living metal. Until the spell ends, its Exhaustion level can't increase; it has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Fire, Piercing, and Slashing damage; and it has Immunity to Poison damage and to the Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions. If it has any of those three conditions when you cast the spell, they end immediately.
eli5: Turn a willing creature into living metal that resists weapon and fire damage and can't be poisoned, paralyzed, petrified, or further exhausted.

name: Lightning Ring
material: a bit of fur and a glass ring
description:
A crackling ring of electricity fills a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. Whenever the Emanation moves into a creature's space, or a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Lightning damage plus 3d6 Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

While the spell lasts, you can take a Magic action to fire a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
eli5: Surround yourself with a 10-foot ring of lightning that shocks and deafens nearby creatures, and use a Magic action to fire 60-foot lightning bolts.

name: Moment of Prescience
castingTrigger: which you take when you fail a D20 Test or when a creature hits you with an attack roll
description: A sudden sixth sense guides you at the perfect moment. Either the d20 roll of your failed D20 Test becomes a 20, or the d20 roll of the attack roll that hit you becomes a 1.
eli5: As a reaction, turn your failed d20 roll into a 20, or turn the d20 of an attack that hit you into a 1.

name: Detonate
description: You plant an explosive magical seed inside a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The seed then explodes: each other creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the target makes a Dexterity saving throw, with Disadvantage if this spell reduced the target to 0 Hit Points, taking 10d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Nonmagical objects in the Emanation that aren't being worn or carried also take the damage, and flammable ones start burning.
eli5: Blow up a creature with 10d10 fire damage, then hit everything within 60 feet of it with another 10d10 fire explosion.

name: Hindsight
material: a tiny hourglass worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: You look backward through time, seeing visions of events that took place within range over the past 10 years, flowing past at about 1 day per second. For the duration, you can slow, pause, rewind, or fast-forward the visions at will.
eli5: Watch the last 10 years of events within 500 feet play back like a recording you can pause and rewind.

name: Invulnerability
material: a piece of adamantine worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: You have Immunity to all damage until the spell ends.
eli5: Become immune to all damage for as long as you keep Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

name: Vision of Elapsing Eons
description: You make a creature you can see within range believe that it and everything around it are crumbling to dust as eons rush by. It must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 10d12 Psychic damage and have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. While Paralyzed, it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: on a failed save it gains 1 Exhaustion level, and on a successful one the spell ends. The spell also ends early if a creature within 5 feet of the target takes an action to shake it out of the illusion.
eli5: A creature that fails an Intelligence save takes 10d12 psychic damage and is Paralyzed, gaining Exhaustion each turn until it breaks free.

name: Wail of the Banshee
description: You let loose a deadly scream. Choose up to ten creatures within range. Each target with 50 Hit Points or fewer dies. Each target with more than 50 Hit Points makes a Constitution saving throw: on a failed save, it takes 12d10 Psychic damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 hour; on a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A target that can't hear you is unaffected.
eli5: Scream so that up to ten creatures with 50 Hit Points or fewer die outright, and tougher ones take 12d10 psychic damage and are Deafened.
